metadata.scope: lefthook.yml direct-edit ack gate + hand-written .git/hooks detection (pre-commit local) + lefthook<->scripts/hooks integrity CI gate; implemented locally (8 files), focused vitest 12 PASS, typecheck/lint green; CI run + commit/push/PR user-gated
metadata.investigationConclusion: Issue #230 was unresolved in current code: no .git/hooks hand-write guard, no lefthook.yml direct-edit guard, no hook-integrity CI gate, and lefthook.yml not in CODEOWNERS. AC-1 'CI fail on .git/hooks hand-write' is structurally infeasible (.git is untracked, absent from CI checkout); re-mapped to a local pre-commit enforcement point plus a CI-observable lefthook<->scripts/hooks integrity gate. Implemented 2026-05-31: 8 files (5 new + 3 edits), focused vitest 12 PASS, typecheck/lint/shellcheck/YAML green. During implementation the hand-written hook exclusion was generalized from '*.sample only' to 'any dotted filename (*.*)' after a real-repo false positive on .git/hooks/*.old backups (git never executes dotted hook names). Commit/push/PR and issue #230 mutation are user-gated.
userGated: CI run of verify-hook-integrity workflow (lands on push)

gates.notes: spec_review: Phase 1-13 spec authored for lefthook-edit-guard (pre-commit) + verify-hook-integrity (CI); AC-1..AC-4 mapped to observable enforcement surfaces
